metadata.description: AI agent quality and development tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: immunity
plugins.description: The immune system for AI-generated code. Adversarial review, self-verifying contracts, change impact tracking, production readiness analysis.

plugins.name: agent-harmony
plugins.description: One prompt to production. Multi-pass quality assurance for autonomous AI development.

plugins.name: feed
plugins.description: SNS content generator & publisher. Interview-driven workflow that creates platform-optimized posts for Threads, X, Reddit, and Dev.to.

plugins.name: team-relay
plugins.description: Real-time agent-to-agent messaging between teammates' Claude Code sessions — self-hosted relay, room-scoped isolation, offline queue with TTL, native cross-session delegation on each machine. Join with /team-relay:join. (Private repo — requires collaborator access to install.)

plugins.name: agent-orchestra
plugins.description: Observable multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code. An orchestrator leads a native Agent Team — project-tailored workers (designed by an agent-architect from quality-floor archetypes) plus a standing reviewer and an adversarial critic — that you watch collaborate live in cmux panes. The gate is objective (a hook re-runs the project's tests/lint/build), frontend work requires Playwright live E2E, and every run appends to an onboarding history index. Includes standard .claude scaffolding, Redmine briefing, and Remote Control flow.
